description: This file contains utility functions and encoders for converting Python objects to JSON-compatible formats, specifically tailored for FastAPI and Pydantic models. It includes custom encoders, handling for various data types, and integration with Pydantic and FastAPI exceptions.

methods.name: isoformat
methods.description: Converts a date or time object to ISO format string.

methods.name: decimal_encoder
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as int if no exponent, otherwise float.

methods.name: generate_encoders_by_class_tuples
methods.description: Creates a mapping from encoders to their associated types.

methods.name: jsonable_encoder
methods.description: Converts Python objects to JSON-compatible data structures, handling various data types and Pydantic models.
